claims.text: Chelate children w encephalopathy or PbB > 45 mcg/dL;
claims.quote: Chelation is indicated for adults with symptoms of poisoning plus PbB > 70 mcg/dL (3.38 micromol/L) and for children with encephalopathy or PbB > 45 mcg/dL (> 2.17 micromol/L)
For all patients, the source of lead should be eliminated

claims.text: and don't chelate during ongoing exposure.
claims.quote: Chelating agents should not be given to any patient with ongoing exposure to lead because chelation can increase gastrointestinal absorption of lead

claims.text: Encephalopathy: dimercaprol 75 mg/m2 IM Q4h + CaNa2EDTA 1000-1500 mg/m2/day IV;
claims.quote: Patients with encephalopathy are treated with dimercaprol 75 mg/m 2 (or 4 mg/kg) IM every 4 hours and CaNa2 EDTA [calcium disodium versenate] 1000 to 1500 mg/m2 IV (infusion) once/day

claims.text: give dimercaprol ± 4 hrs b4 the first EDTA dose (prevents lead moving into the brain).
claims.quote: The first dose of dimercaprol should precede the first dose of CaNa 2 EDTA by at least 4 hours to prevent redistribution of lead into the brain

claims.text: ⍉encephalopathy: USU succimer 10 mg/kg PO Q8h for 5 days, then Q12h for 14 days;
claims.quote: Patients without encephalopathy are usually treated with succimer 10 mg/kg orally every 8 hours for 5 days, followed by 10 mg/kg orally every 12 hours for 14 days

claims.text: if Sxtomatic, dimercaprol 50 mg/m2 IM Q4h + CaNa2EDTA 1000 mg/m2/day IV for 5 days instead.
claims.quote: If these patients have symptoms, they can alternatively be treated for 5 days with dimercaprol 50 mg/m 2 via deep IM injection every 4 hours plus CaNa2EDTA 1000 mg/m2 IV once/day
Dimercaprol is formulated with peanut derivatives and thus is contraindicated in patients with known or suspected peanut allergy

claims.text: can cause hemolysis in G6PD deficiency;
claims.quote: in patients with G6PD deficiency, moderate to severe acute intravascular hemolysis
This medication should not be given concurrently with iron supplements
Before beginning treatment with CaNa2 EDTA, adequate urine flow must be confirmed
Renal toxicity, which is dose-related, is usually reversible
CaNa2 EDTA (calcium disodium versenate) can cause thrombophlebitis

claims.text: Succimer: rash, GI upset, metallic taste, transient liver enzyme rise.
claims.quote: Succimer may cause rash, gastrointestinal symptoms (eg, anorexia, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, metallic taste), and transient elevations of liver enzymes
